info.title: Xenode Internal API
info.description:
🔒 **INTERNAL USE ONLY** — This API reference is for internal development and integration purposes. All endpoints require authentication via session cookie or API key bearer token.

Xenode is a zero-knowledge encrypted cloud storage platform. The backend never sees raw file contents or unencrypted keys. All E2EE operations (encrypt, decrypt, key wrapping) are performed client-side.

get.description:
All authentication routes handled by better-auth. Includes sign-up, sign-in, email verification, Google OAuth, session management, and token refresh.

**Session:** 7-day expiry, auto-refresh every 24h.
**Custom fields:** `user.onboarded`, `user.encryptByDefault`.

post.description: Verifies the user's current password before sensitive operations.

get.description: Returns all OAuth/credential accounts linked to the authenticated user.

post.description: Initiates the account recovery process for vault/key recovery.
Finalizes the recovery process and restores vault access.
Generates WebAuthn registration options for the user's browser.
Verifies and stores the WebAuthn credential after user confirmation.
Generates WebAuthn authentication options.
Verifies the WebAuthn assertion and creates a session.
Rate-limited to 5 requests per minute per user.

get.description: Returns the system bucket and user's root prefix. Auto-creates the global B2 bucket if it doesn't exist yet.
Returns files and folders with full metadata, signed thumbnail/optimized URLs. Supports pagination, filtering by bucket/folder, content type, and media category.
Returns pre-signed download URL (or chunk URLs for chunked files) with encryption metadata.

delete.description: Deletes from B2 storage and frees storage quota.

post.description: Replaces the binary content of an existing object with a new version.
Finalizes a content update after direct-to-B2 re-upload.

get.summary: Get lightweight object metadata (IDs + dates only)
get.description: Returns `{ _id, createdAt }` for every object in a bucket in a single unpaginated response. Used by the gallery to layout placeholders and the scrubber timeline. ~25 KB gzipped for 5,000 photos.

post.description: Returns full object data with signed thumbnail/optimized URLs for a batch of IDs. Max 200 IDs per request. Uses POST to avoid URL length limits and prevent CDN caching of short-TTL signed URLs.
Generates a pre-signed URL for direct-to-B2 upload. Checks storage quotas.
For very large files. Generates multipart pre-signed URLs for chunked direct-to-B2 upload.
After direct-to-B2 upload succeeds, notifies backend to save metadata, apply E2EE details, and increment storage quota.
Alternative to the presign flow. Uploads file through the Next.js server directly to B2. Uses `multipart/form-data`. Enforces storage access and quota.
Updates metadata for a storage object, typically after a Google Photos migration upload. Accepts `takenAt`, `createdAt`, `description`, `googlePhotosUrl`.

get.description: Returns a signed download URL for a thumbnail by its B2 key. Auth is optional for `shares/` prefixed keys.

Validates access (password if required) and returns a signed download URL.

Shares an encrypted file directly with specific users. Each recipient gets a wrapped share key for their own vault.
